_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. Every machine takes one cartridge; the Mega Drive alone can take Sega CD discs instead - the exposedWhen conditions make the two mutually exclusive, and hide the drive entirely on a machine that has none.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The cartridge rom for the machine chosen with the core: .md/.gen/.bin/.smd/.mdx for a Mega Drive, .sms, .gg or .sg for the others. The machine comes from the project, not from the file name, and a cartridge for another console is refused at load.

slots.title: Sega CD discs
slots.help: Sega CD / Mega CD disc images: a .cue sheet whose referenced track files join the project automatically, or a raw single-track .iso/.bin dump. The first disc is in the drive at boot; the order here is the swap order used by the Previous/Next Disk inputs. Needs the matching region's CD BIOS on the firmware page.
